target_audience: Neighbors who already walk past the new shop on their way to work
core_feeling: That the roastery down the street is part of their morning, not a chain
call_to_action: Stop in at the second shop this week
key_message: Ember & Oak roasts small batches in the back room of its original shop and opens a second location a short walk away, with every bag labeled by roast date.
exclusions: No stock hipster-barista tropes or forced smiles
No claims we cannot source, such as best coffee in town
references: The handheld camera work of Richard Linklater's 'Before Sunrise' to capture the intimacy of a short walk
The natural lighting and grain of Terrence Malick's 'Days of Heaven' to emphasize the warmth of the roasting process
The ambient soundscape of 'The World of the Lonely Wolf' to create a grounded, communal atmosphere
